issues.description: Field Farm.animals visibility differs between the problem statement UML and the solution: the UML and task text indicate a private attribute ("- animals: List<Animal>") and instruct students to provide a getter and setter for Farm, but the solution declares the field as public (public List<Animal> animals;). This mismatch can confuse students about the intended encapsulation (whether to make the field private and use getAnimals()/setAnimals() or expose it publicly).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Farm.animals field private to match the UML and the instruction to provide getter/setter (change to 'private List<Animal> animals;'), and keep the existing getAnimals()/setAnimals() methods. Update the template and solution Farm.java files accordingly so students implement/access the list via the accessor methods, preserving intended encapsulation.
